voice.refText: Twice a week, you sell your plasma, the pale part of your blood. It's the most the law allows. That's the band. A thin strip you wear across your forehead. While you sleep, it lends your brain to a company. And it pays you, by the hour.

Boss.describe: A cheerful male baritone: an office boss in his late forties. Hearty and pleased with himself, brisk, a grin in the voice, crisp clear diction, every word distinct.

Leader.describe: A smooth, deep male baritone: a national politician in his sixties at a lectern. Practised and measured, every word polished and reassuring, crisp clear diction, every word distinct.

Flatmate.describe: A relaxed male baritone: a man of about thirty in a dressing gown, your flatmate. Easy and warm, a little sleepy, unbothered, crisp clear diction, every word distinct, casual modern English.

Bus man.describe: A loud, cheerful male baritone: a man in his thirties on the phone at the back of a bus. Easy and breezy, warm, clear diction, every word distinct.

Desk woman.describe: A brisk female alto: an office worker in her forties at a stand-up meeting. Breezy and quick, clear diction, every word distinct.

Desk man.describe: A clipped male tenor-baritone: an office worker in his twenties. Casual and a little too quick, clear diction, every word distinct.

Printer man.describe: A flat male bass: an office worker in his fifties. Bored and certain, short words, clear diction, every word distinct.

Mechanic one.describe: A plain, gruff male baritone: a garage mechanic in his forties wiping his hands. Matter-of-fact and honest, clear diction, every word distinct.

Mechanic two.describe: A smooth, gruff male baritone: a garage mechanic in his forties. Grave and confident, a salesman's sigh, clear diction, every word distinct.

Date.describe: A light male tenor: a man in his thirties on a first date. Eager and a little nervous, sitting up straight, clear diction, every word distinct.

Woman diner.describe: A warm female mezzo: a woman in her thirties at a restaurant table, glass raised. Coy and playful, clear diction, every word distinct.

Man diner.describe: A warm male baritone: a man in his thirties at a restaurant table. Quick and charming, clear diction, every word distinct.

Player.describe: A low, steady male bass: a poker player in his forties pushing his chips in. Cool and slow, a deliberate bluff, clear diction, every word distinct.

Quiet player.describe: A flat, quiet male baritone: a poker player in his sixties who never smiles. Calm and dry, almost bored, few words, clear diction, every word distinct.

Guest.describe: A curious female mezzo: a party guest in her twenties holding up her phone. Bright and earnest, clear diction, every word distinct.

Host.describe: A bright female mezzo: a television host in her thirties with a microphone. Quick, warm and theatrical, a showman's lift, crisp clear diction, every word distinct.

Striker.describe: A loud male tenor: a footballer in his twenties on the ground. Outraged and theatrical, shouting, clear diction, every word distinct.

Colleague.describe: A soft female mezzo: an office colleague in her thirties at the lift at five o'clock. Kind and a little worried, clear diction, every word distinct.

Rival.describe: A pompous male baritone: a self-styled expert in his fifties in a white coat. Slow and grand, pleased with himself, crisp clear diction, every word distinct.

Challenger.describe: A firm female alto: a politician in her fifties, the challenger. Dry and direct, a hint of amusement, crisp clear diction, every word distinct.
